description: Temurin smoke test stage parameters. The Temurin implementation runs AQA extended.functional/buildAndPackage tests and does not use a configurable timeout — all timing is driven by TKG make targets.

parameterGroups.name: Source Control
parameterGroups.description: Refs that pin exactly what source is checked out for this stage. Leave empty to use the defaults defined in adoptium_pipeline_config.json.

parameters.name: AQA_REF
parameters.description: Git branch or tag for the aqa-tests repository. Empty = default defined in adoptium_pipeline_config.json.

parameters.name: BUILD_REF
parameters.description: Git branch or tag for the temurin-build repository (vendor test sources). Empty = default defined in adoptium_pipeline_config.json.
